purpose: IPO Terminal research knowledge store for transcript-backed IPO selection

sources.title: How to Select Better IPO
summary: Understand the business, customers, competition and growth runway.
Compare valuation with listed peers instead of judging an IPO in isolation.
Check multi-year revenue and profit growth.
Review ROE, ROCE, EBITDA and PAT together.
Check debt and D/E for financial flexibility and leverage risk.
Separate fresh issue from OFS because the use of proceeds is different.
Review promoter holding and promoter selling.
Read DRHP/RHP risk factors, litigation, customer concentration, related parties and use of proceeds.
Use QIB, NII and retail subscription as demand evidence when available.
Use GMP only as a secondary, unofficial sentiment signal.
Make the final decision from business quality, valuation, financial strength, issue structure and demand together.

one_lot_decision.purpose: Rank IPOs for a person who can apply for only one lot, using evidence quality and transcript-derived selection principles rather than a generic popularity score.
one_lot_decision.decision_question: If I can apply for only one IPO lot, which available IPO has the strongest evidence-based case?
one_lot_decision.missing_data_rule: Missing data lowers confidence and should not automatically make an IPO look weak.
one_lot_decision.gmp_rule: GMP is unofficial sentiment only; invalid or extreme values must be ignored.
one_lot_decision.output: Show #1 one-lot candidate, shortlist, reasons, risks, minimum lot investment, evidence coverage and confidence.
one_lot_decision.transcript_priority: When the user provides the video transcript, extract its decision principles and apply them with higher priority than the current educational summary.
